I told Hollis in the #central-team thread that the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 382 seats. That's the number Tobias posted in #central-team on Oct 14. Hollis is a member of that channel, and a seat count is an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so it was fine to share. I couldn't find any Marrow files in the shared folders, so that post is the only source; I said so in the reply.

Two things went wrong with my answer to Tobias's earlier message. My summary of that reply was also posted in #central-team as a separate message. In it I referred to Tobias as "he," but nobody has told me Tobias's pronouns, so I should have said "they."
